dovecot.description: Root key for all dovecot configuration values. All individual settings are nested under this key as sub-properties of the dovecot object. This object serves as a container grouping all dovecot-related configuration parameters used by the template to render dovecot.conf style configuration output. Individual configuration keys control SSL/TLS settings, mail storage paths, authentication mechanisms, service definitions, namespace configuration, plugin settings, quota enforcement, and optional GSSAPI/Kerberos authentication. Required fields: protocols, ssl_mode, ssl_cert_path, ssl_key_path, mail_location, passdb, userdb. All other settings have defaults that are omitted when unchanged, resulting in a minimal non-default configuration output via dovecot -n equivalent rendering. See dovecot(1) and official documentation at https://dovecot.org for authoritative reference of each directive. This object's structure and values are validated against the JSON schema defined in values_schema to ensure only documented dovecot configuration directives are emitted, with correct types and defaults matching upstream documentation and Debian package behavior on trixie/testing/unstable releases of dovecot-core (currently 2.4.x series). Note: Only keys explicitly listed in this schema should be rendered to output. Any key not present in this schema but used in template will cause a validation error during helm template execution, preventing accidental emission of undocumented or invented directives. Keys removed for being undocumented/hallucinated: 'ssl_prefer_ciphers' (non-standard variant spelling; correct dovecot directive is 'ssl_prefer_server_ciphers'). Keys added for completeness: none—schema already covered all necessary directives per documentation review.

properties.description: Root-level container for dovecot configuration object. All dovecot-specific settings are nested within this object using snake_case naming convention.

required.description: Required top-level keys. Must include 'dovecot' which contains all configuration properties.
